mapper.sql: id, owner_account_id, request_key, source_code, source_program_id, COALESCE( (SELECT p.title FROM support_program p WHERE p.source_code = application_form_discovery_job.source_code AND p.source_program_id = application_form_discovery_job.source_program_id), '공고 정보를 확인하지 못한 작업' ) AS program_title, (SELECT p.source_url FROM support_program p WHERE p.source_code = application_form_discovery_job.source_code AND p.source_program_id = application_form_discovery_job.source_program_id) AS program_source_url, status, failure_code, created_at, seen_at
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM account WHERE id = #{ownerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND suspended_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT , result_json FROM application_form_discovery_job WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND request_key = #{requestKey}
SELECT , result_json FROM application_form_discovery_job WHERE source_code = #{sourceCode} AND source_program_id = #{sourceProgramId} AND active_slot = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM application_form_discovery_job WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerId} AND active_slot = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO application_form_discovery_job (owner_account_id, request_key, source_code, source_program_id, created_at, next_publish_at) VALUES (#{ownerAccountId}, #{requestKey}, #{sourceCode}, #{sourceProgramId}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT , result_json FROM application_form_discovery_job WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT , result_json FROM application_form_discovery_job WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_account_id = #{ownerId}
SELECT FROM application_form_discovery_job WHERE owner_account_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE application_form_discovery_job j INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = j.owner_account_id SET j.status = 'RUNNING', j.started_at = #{now} WHERE j.id = #{id} AND j.status = 'QUEUED' AND j.created_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.suspended_at IS NULL

UPDATE application_form_discovery_job j INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = j.owner_account_id SET j.ai_started_at = #{now} WHERE j.id = #{id} AND j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.ai_started_at IS NULL AND j.started_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 20 MINUTE) AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.suspended_at IS NULL

UPDATE application_form_discovery_job SET status = #{status}, result_json = #{resultJson}, failure_code = #{failureCode}, finished_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 20 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM application_form_discovery_job WHERE status = 'QUEUED' AND created_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND next_publish_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE application_form_discovery_job SET next_publish_at = DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND created_at > DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) AND next_publish_at <= #{now}
UPDATE application_form_discovery_job SET last_published_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE application_form_discovery_job j INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = j.owner_account_id SET j.status = 'FAILED', j.failure_code = CASE WHEN a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.suspended_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'ACCOUNT_INACTIVE' ELSE 'QUEUE_EXPIRED' END, j.finished_at = #{now} WHERE j.status = 'QUEUED' AND (j.created_at <= DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OR a.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR a.suspended_at IS NOT NULL)

UPDATE application_form_discovery_job SET status = 'UNKNOWN', failure_code = 'RUN_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN', finished_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND started_at <= DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL 20 MINUTE)

UPDATE application_form_discovery_job j INNER JOIN application_form_availability v ON v.source_code = j.source_code AND v.source_program_id = j.source_program_id SET j.status = 'FAILED', j.failure_code = 'RUN_OUTCOME_SETTLED' WHERE j.status = 'UNKNOWN' AND v.status <> 'PENDING' AND (v.lease_until IS NULL OR v.lease_until <= #{now}) AND v.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND v.verified_at >= COALESCE(j.ai_started_at, j.started_at, j.created_at)
UPDATE application_form_discovery_job SET status = 'FAILED', failure_code = 'RUN_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN_EXPIRED' WHERE status = 'UNKNOWN' AND finished_at <= DATE_SUB(#{now}, INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND)
